objectivity.smokingGun: Netflix explicitly refuses to keep score: “We have no bell curves or rankings or quotas such as 'cut the bottom 10% every year'” — while demanding you be a “high performer” judged by a manager's gut (the keeper test).
objectivity.finding: Pervasive objectivity rhetoric, no defined metric. The language borrows sports' objectivity without its scoreboard.
